description: This file defines the SemanticContext interface and its implementations (Predicate, PrecedencePredicate, AND, OR) used for recording semantic contexts in ANTLR's Go runtime, including logical operations and evaluation methods.

classes.name: Predicate
classes.description: Represents a predicate with rule and predicate indices, and context dependency flag.

classes.name: PrecedencePredicate
classes.description: Represents a precedence predicate used in semantic context evaluation.

classes.name: AND
classes.description: Represents a logical AND of multiple semantic contexts.

classes.name: OR
classes.description: Represents a logical OR of multiple semantic contexts.

methods.name: SemanticContextandContext
methods.description: Combines two semantic contexts with logical AND.

methods.name: SemanticContextorContext
methods.description: Combines two semantic contexts with logical OR.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the semantic context with a parser and outer context.

methods.name: evalPrecedence
methods.description: Evaluates the semantic context considering precedence.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Computes a hash code for the semantic context.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns string representation of the semantic context.

methods.name: PrecedencePredicatefilterPrecedencePredicates
methods.description: Filters precedence predicates from a set.

methods.name: NewAND
methods.description: Constructs an AND semantic context from two contexts.

methods.name: NewOR
methods.description: Constructs an OR semantic context from two contexts.
